name: Freeze canonical contracts
objective: Freeze IDs, object classes, rights dimensions and migration invariants.

name: Import and normalize existing corpus
objective: Import 84 UE sources + 34 Work sources, 170 UE topics + 885 Work topics, UE atom index and Work claims without semantic collapse.
exit: 118 source records imported or deduplicated with provenance

name: Complete rights audit
objective: Audit all Work sources and new source families at document level.

name: Acquire open corpus
objective: Download Open RN 10-book corpus and priority open/public sources by specialty.

name: Atomize evidence
objective: Convert lawful full text to immutable source blocks/evidence atoms, deduplicate and index.
exit: every active atom has source+locator+hash+rights snapshot
blocked source text absent from default FTS/vector

name: Canonical semantic promotion
objective: Generate/review concepts, claims and knowledge atoms from curricula + evidence.
exit: no topic promoted solely from title expansion
P0 clinical claims have required evidence
normative claims point to primary act

name: Tools, scales and libraries
objective: Promote calculators/scales/scores and build reusable libraries linked many-to-many to specialties.
exit: proprietary forms not reproduced without permission

name: Specialty saturation
objective: Run curriculum + corpus discovery for Perioperative/CME/RA then all recognized nursing specialties.
exit: 3 consecutive acquisition/discovery waves add <2% new canonical topics per specialty
all P0 gaps resolved or explicitly blocked

name: Editorial production
objective: Compose publishable content from validated knowledge atoms; generate formats.

name: Reverse audit and release
objective: Reverse-walk publication to claim/evidence/source/license and forward-walk source to usages.
